court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Lassen
case_search_note: Case Index & Calendar Portal (linked from https://www.lassen.courts.ca.gov/online-services/case-index-calendar-portal). Covers non-confidential cases filed after about 1994, including criminal and traffic; shows calendars, docket (Register of Actions), fines owed. Court says it is for reference only, not the official record, and may lag several days. Most in-custody defendants are added to the calendar the morning of court and may not appear online.

courthouses.name: Hall of Justice
courthouses.hours: Building: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Phone: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and 1:00–4:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Only courthouse in Lassen County; hears all case types including criminal (felony/misdemeanor), traffic, juvenile, family, civil, probate. For criminal clerk press 1 (case information) then 2 (Criminal). In-custody arraignments held daily as needed here. Warrant clear calendars Mondays and Fridays (times on the court's Law & Motion Calendars page). Staff will not look up criminal records by phone.

public_defenders.name: Lassen County Public Defender (court-appointed counsel)
public_defenders.note: Court's Criminal Division page: a public defender may be appointed for eligible defendants who cannot afford an attorney; ask the judge at your first appearance and complete a financial declaration; a reimbursement hearing at the end of the case decides whether you repay costs. Ability-to-pay questions: Office of Recovery & Reimbursement (530) 251-8227. Public Defender is NOT listed on the current lassencounty.gov Departments page, and the court's link to the old co.lassen.ca.us PD page fails (bad certificate).

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Redding Office (Shasta Regional)
legal_aid.serves: Lassen, Modoc, Shasta, Siskiyou and Tehama counties (civil legal aid)
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing, public benefits, education rights, healthcare benefits, guardianship help for grandparents 55+. Office page does not list criminal defense or record clearing.
legal_aid.hours: Intake Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 9:00–11:45 a.m. and 1:00–4:45 p.m.

legal_aid.name: California Courts Self-Help — Clean Your Record
legal_aid.what: Statewide guide to expungement (PC 1203.4, forms CR-180/CR-181) and certificates of rehabilitation; linked from the Lassen court's Criminal Division page.

probation.name: Lassen County Probation Department
probation.note: Supervises adult offenders; county page says Probation also operates the county's juvenile detention/residential treatment facilities and home supervision program (no address given). Court lists 'Probation Pretrial Resources' under Justice Partners but that page is login-only.

programs.name: Ability to Pay / Financial Hardship (traffic & criminal fines)
programs.summary: If you cannot pay fines in full within 7 business days, report to the Office of Recovery & Reimbursement ((530) 251-8227). Court has a Financial Hardship page under Traffic.

jails.name: Lassen County Adult Detention Facility (Jail)
jails.phone_note: Jail / inmate information line (per court Criminal page and Sheriff's Office page). Sheriff's Office: (530) 251-8013. Dispatch: (530) 257-6121.
jails.note: Holds pre-trial and sentenced adults; rated capacity 156. Only criminal courthouse in county is the Hall of Justice (in-custody arraignments held there daily as needed).
jails.todo: Sheriff page does not say whether men, women or both are housed, and publishes no visiting, money/commissary or inmate-lookup info — confirm by calling (530) 251-5245. Juvenile facility run by Probation: name/address not published.
